data.body: Plan review PASS (art_01KZQPR6MEQDQWG26FJD1W1FYC). Resolved all four minor findings in plan review cycle 1: speaker handoff evidence, genuine misspellings, route-table enumeration, and no-debounce timing.

Validation evidence for MRQ-29 at pushed head 5cce6af:

- npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-29 passed: test 9,997 ms / 30,000 (44 tests), merged AC trace live 212 / testFiles 59 / claims 28 / uncovered 0 / errors 0, whole pr-gate 12,481 ms / 45,000.
- Final-head Wrangler + Playwright AC-103 flow (the same quickSearchPaintSamples block) ran all ten terms: agent, Casy, RAG, zzzz-no-match, Leadership, Marriott, Aicha, session, Dhinkran, retrieval systms. Samples were 67.80, 41.57, 40.19, 116.37, 103.37, 71.06, 56.49, 74.20, 77.88, 109.72 ms; p95 116.37 ms, under the 200 ms budget. No navigation occurred.
- The canonical npm run check:speed invocation still stops before AC-103 at the pre-existing /portal transition: scripts/checks/speed.ts:290 waits for .page, but the separate PortalPage contract does not render .page. This is a harness precondition failure, not an AC-103 measurement; the exact AC-103 block was measured directly above.
- Live local Wrangler browser validation saw / and Control-K open the dialog without changing /dashboard; Abstract, Speaker, and Form selections navigated to /submissions/sub_synthetic-pool-0004, /onboarding?person=per_edge-aicha-ndiaye-kovacs, and /forms?form=frm_cfp, respectively, and closed the dialog. The demo seed has no submissions.kind=session row; the AC-102 Worker fixture exercises the Session label and /submissions/:id canonical href.
- Code review PASS: art_01KZQV58NGCPDSHSN86PWKHFXB. Its minor observations are non-blocking: inert number hints, one-frame reset concern addressed by per-open remount, naming, fixture misspelling spelling, and stale-base hygiene.
- AC-104 integration assertions include status plus absence of leaked IDs/titles and positive controls. The integration fixture uses sgnal as the fuzzy misspelling; the browser speed flow uses the planned retrieval systms, Casy, and Dhinkran misspellings.

Rebased validation refresh: head 6e301cd on master 3be1909c after npm ci. Direct AC-103 final-head Wrangler/Playwright run passed all ten planned terms with samples 71.15, 43.26, 39.20, 132.86, 107.94, 85.74, 62.60, 78.15, 92.91, 170.19 ms; p95 170.19 ms <= 200 ms; no navigation.
